main.description: People whose public profiles resemble a posting, for the posting's author only. Requires service auth (lxm = this NSID) from the author. Hybrid search: the posting's embedding against profile embeddings, plus full-text search on its title and skills, fused with RRF. Only people whose profile says they are open to work are included, and the author is left out. Protected-attribute wording in the posting has no effect. Candidates come in rank order; no score is given for any person.
